source: ISO 14229-1 Annex C.1 identification DIDs 0xF180-0xF19F (0xF18F is reserved and omitted); names cross-checked with commaai/opendbc opendbc/car/uds.py (MIT)

params.name: Boot software identification
params.description: ISO 14229-1 identification DID 0xF180. Manufacturer-defined byte record; shown as a raw number of its first 8 bytes.
